**Nit** · A "link sent" message can stay after the email is changed

`sent` is shared state for the whole visit and is only set to true. On DK, if a player sends a link and then saves a changed email, `handleSuccess` refetches the status and the new address is unverified. `sent` is still true, so the profile shows "We sent a verification link to <new email>" although nothing was sent to it, and the 60 s cooldown keeps the button disabled. Reset `sent` and the cooldown when the email changes, or tie them to the address that was sent to.

<sub>Found by Claude</sub>
